identity: One charged molecular carrier on an infinite cubic center lattice, with a co-moving neutral quantum orientor. It is not an array of independent stationary neutral rotors. The neutral internal state is preserved through every center hop. The polar z bias breaks cubic symmetry to C4v while translation remains exact.
units: hbar=1, center spacing a=1, all energies in the input rotor/contact energy unit; primitive charge e_c=-1. No conversion to SI electron mass or photon normalization.
state: ell_c=0,1,2 complete angular shells (9) tensor primitive spin (2) tensor ell_n=0,1,2 complete angular shells (9): 162 states at EVERY k, no four-state delivery reduction. Center Bloch k is a genuine reciprocal-lattice momentum. The real-space packet uses 128 periodic x cells at fixed ky=.18, kz=0.
H0: Delta + Ic_inverse Lc^2/2 + In_inverse Ln^2/2 + g sum_i Rc_i Rn_i + kappa sum_i S_i Ln_i + b Rc_z. Rc and Rn are Galerkin projections of actual unit-sphere coordinate multiplication in full spherical harmonic shells.
contact_geometry: At direction d, y_d[a]=Y_(ell,m)(d/|d|). T_d[a,b]=-t conjugate(y_d[a]) y_(-d)[b] / sum_a |y_d[a]|^2. T_d is identity on primitive spin and neutral orientation. Row orbital is evaluated at the +d face of cell R and column orbital at the -d face of cell R+d. Center-bond tunneling is a phenomenological point-contact integral using actual angular orbital values; radial overlap/amplitude t and lattice geometry remain inputs.
Hk: H(k)=H0+sum_(d=a ex,ey,ez)[T_d exp(i k.d)+T_d^dagger exp(-i k.d)]. This gives genuine 3D translation dispersion. Polar spin splitting is generated after joint diagonalization; no intercell Dirac alpha or spin hopping is prescribed.
gauge_source: A is an external lattice-center vector source coupled by the complete Peierls straight-link integral: T_(R,R+d) -> T exp[-i e_c integral_R^(R+d) A(x).dx]. Uniform A gives H(k-e_c A). Internal angular motion is NOT minimally coupled to this source. Thus this is the conserved center-transport current/contact, not a microscopic full EM current of the molecular shell.
Gamma: J(kout,kin;epsilon)=i e_c sum_d (epsilon.d) sinc[(kout-kin).d/2] [T_d exp(i kbar.d)-T_d^dagger exp(-i kbar.d)], kbar=(kout+kin)/2, sinc(x)=sin(x)/x. J=-dH/dA.
continuity: (kout-kin).J_vector = e_c [H(kout)-H(kin)]. This finite-q lattice identity follows from 2 sin(q.d/2)=q.d sinc(q.d/2).
contact: C=-e_c^2 sum_d (epsilon_out*.d)(epsilon_in.d) sinc(qout.d/2) sinc(qin.d/2) [T_d exp(i kbar.d)+T_d^dagger exp(-i kbar.d)]. This is the actual mixed second Peierls derivative, with kout=kin+qin-qout. The negative curvature of individual bond terms is not an invalid contact.
physical_spin: S is primitive spin/2, not a relabeled band Pauli matrix. Transport spin current J_S^a={S_a,J}/2. Torque dS/dt=i[H,S]=i kappa[Ln.S,S]; neutral orientor exchange and orbital/orientor coupling transfer physical spin structure to the spin-independent spatial contacts. Total internal rotation generator Lc+Ln+S has spinor 2pi sign, but spin-1/2 itself is supplied, not derived.
G: Empty-charge addition response G_ab(k,z)=B^dagger [z-H(k)]^(-1) B, B creates any charged angular/spin channel with neutral ell0. There are 18 source channels; spectral residues sum to I18. It has no occupied-hole or positron claim.
memory: P selects neutral ell0, Q retains all 144 other states. Exact Sigma_P(k,z)=H_PQ [z-H_QQ]^(-1) H_QP, with z-dependent self-energy and exact Schur identity. This is quantum orientor memory retained by the carrier, not an induced EM field.
interaction: T_fi = <f|C|i> + sum_n <f|J_emission|n,kin+qin><n|J_absorption|i>/(Ei+omega_in-En+i eta) + sum_n <f|J_absorption|n,kin-qout><n|J_emission|i>/(Ei-omega_out-En+i eta). ALL 162 states at each intermediate momentum are retained. omega_out=omega_in+Ei-Ef, actual center recoil kout=kin+qin-qout. External transverse source polarization is supplied; there is no photon propagator, occupation, or inferred cross-section.
rest_and_inertia: Vacuum energy reference is empty charge=0; k0 addition energy includes supplied Delta. Kinetic curvature is independently measured from the mean lowest doublet energy, not a parity gap. The polar linear splitting can move the true minimum away from k0; k0 energy is therefore not called a relativistic rest mass. No equality E_rest=m_inertial*c^2 is asserted.
contrary: b=0 restores centrosymmetric pair degeneracy. g=0 removes charged-to-neutral orientation transfer and gives low spin-degenerate transport. kappa=0 also removes low splitting. t=0 removes actual propagation and every center-current interaction/contact.
source_reference: rich_mobile_spinor_20261014_model.py, all newly implemented; historical molecular spinor is a conceptual lead only, not an imported eigenbasis or cached proof.
limitations: Chosen quantum angular shells, primitive charge/spin, torque coupling, contact hopping, co-moving neutral composite, crystal and polar bias are inputs.
Finite angular Galerkin truncation is explicit; complete shells are retained but infinite-ell convergence is unmeasured.
Polar Rashba-like small splitting is real in this model but is not isotropic Dirac propagation or Lorentz invariance.
No dynamical electromagnetic field, induced photon, vacuum pair sector, negative-energy positron or radiative g-2 is delivered.

The opposite-helicity nonforward channel rotates physical spin with momentum; it is not by itself a fixed-axis spin-flip measurement, especially when contrary controls have degenerate arbitrary eigenframes.
